name: Marble-Run Machine
summary: A kraft-cardboard marble run where metrics roll through stencilled gates and the failing marble is diverted to a coral review cup.
look: Corrugated kraft cardboard, taped tracks, spray-stencil labels and glossy teal glass marbles. One coral marble, one coral review cup, a brass finish bell.

components.name: Track
components.role: a stroked SVG path with cardboard edge, face and groove layers

components.name: Marble
components.role: teal glass sphere with specular dot and contact shadow; one per event

components.name: Gate flap
components.role: a stencilled arch whose flap ticks teal when a marble passes

components.name: Diverter flipper
components.role: swings to route a failing marble out of the main run

components.name: Review cup
components.role: the coral checkpoint where the human decides

components.name: Finish bell
components.role: brass bell that rings for “all clear” — the CTA beat

motion.name: Path roll
motion.how: MotionPath with power1.in on descents, rotation tied to distance travelled; gate crossings are timed to beats

motion.name: Domino chain
motion.how: each gate's flap tick triggers the next marble release — one gate per beat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Flipper snap
motion.how: 0 → 40° in 0.12 s, back.out(3), exactly on the snare; the marble's drop into the cup lands on the following downbeat

story: Hook: marbles tumble off a broken track into a box stencilled “Found on Friday”. Reveal: on the drop a hopper under the Acme mark plate pours marbles into a new track and the “Acme Pulse” sign swings in. Proof: marbles tick through SIGNUPS, LATENCY, ERRORS and CHECKOUT gates; the flipper diverts the coral marble to REVIEW, a taped card reads “Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231”, and the human presses “Roll back”. CTA: cleared marbles ring the bell — “You ship. Pulse watches.” and “Start free”.
adapt: Name the gates after the checks your product runs (tests, fraud rules, SLAs) and make the review cup your product's approval step; everything that passes rings the bell.

fit.risk: Clutter; cap it at 4 gates and 1 diverter so the coral marble stays the hero.
